commands.name: crew
commands.description: Open the crew dashboard: every member session at a glance

commands.name: crew-name
commands.description: Name this session on the crew dashboard: /crew-name Ada
commands.output: This session shows as preview-. Usage: /crew-name Venus

commands.name: crew-refresh
commands.description: Refresh this session from a handover: after a task, at a package boundary, or now
commands.output: Auto-refresh is off for preview-. Usage: /crew-refresh auto | package [all] | on [percent] | off | now. Every session also hands over at 70% and takes no new card at 50%.

commands.name: crew-goal
commands.description: Show the crew's goal, or set it: /crew-goal <package refs> <sentence>

commands.name: crew-park
commands.description: Park this session so wake-on-idle leaves it alone: /crew-park, and /crew-park off
commands.output: preview- is parked: wake-on-idle no longer wakes it, and the dashboard shows it parked. /crew-park off unparks it.

commands.name: crew-report
commands.description: The crew ledger for a week: per package cost, cycle time, owner wait and rework

commands.name: crew-sound
commands.description: Bell and desktop notification when a session starts waiting on you: /crew-sound off mutes
commands.output: Crew alerts when a session starts waiting on the owner: bell and notification, for the whole crew. Usage: /crew-sound on | off | bell | notify

commands.name: crew-budget
commands.description: Show the budget gauges, or set the Fable one: /crew-budget fable 56
commands.output: No budget reading yet. Usage: /crew-budget shows the budget. /crew-budget fable <percent> sets the Fable gauge, /crew-budget fable off clears it.

commands.name: crew-progress
commands.description: Turn progress reporting on or off for this session: /crew-progress off
commands.output: Progress reporting is on for this session. Usage: /crew-progress on|off

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Report progress on your current assigned task to the crew dashboard the owner watches. Call it when you start a task (step 0), after each meaningful step, and once when done (step equal to of). Returns nothing useful; carry on with your work.

tools.name: crew_park
tools.description: Park or unpark this session on the crew dashboard the owner watches. A parked member is never woken on idle. Call it with parked 1 when the Supervisor or the owner tells you to stop or wind down, and with parked 0 when told to resume.

tools.name: crew_refresh
tools.description: Refresh this session from a handover, now, whatever its refresh mode. Call it when the Supervisor or the owner tells you to refresh, then end your turn: the crew mod asks you for your handover, clears this session and resumes it. The refresh mode is left as it was.

tools.name: crew_restart
tools.description: Restart a crew member headless: stop it cleanly (its own process group) and start it again in a detached tmux session, no kitty needed. For the Supervisor: use it when a member is stalled or a fix needs a relaunch. the owner's approval is needed for pushes, tags and fleet changes, not for member restarts.

tools.name: queue_ask
tools.description: Queue a routine yes/no ask for the owner instead of opening a menu for it: a cleanup, a branch or worktree to delete. The Supervisor offers queued asks together. Never queue part of a change: a change's asks go in one menu.

tools.name: crew_model
tools.description: Switch this session to the model your assignment names, when you start that package, or back with model "back". The crew mod switches after this turn, and back to your own model when you finish or release a card of that package or park.

tools.name: crew_log
tools.description: Log a work package milestone in the crew's ledger, which the owner reads to tune the crew for cost and speed. The Supervisor logs assigned, ask_sent, owner_yes, sent_back, live, closed; members log checkpoint, release, fix_after_ship, fable_round.

tools.name: take_asks
tools.description: Take every queued routine ask, oldest first, to offer them to the owner in one multi-select menu. The queue is emptied.

tools.name: crew_receipts
tools.description: List the instructions this session sent to members and their delivery state, one line per message: delivered, answered, or pending. The receiving host acknowledges a delivery with a receipt fact on the room; an OpenCode member's host cannot publish one yet, and its lines say so. Read-only.
